scope: Owner-steered Liquid Glass Plymouth boot scene: source artwork, Blender renders and native private-renderer pixels. Not a DRM boot, final initramfs, signed artifact or installed acceptance.
ownerSteering: Asked to continue the boot screen in Blender with a beautiful Arabic animated design.

Rejected the first neon khatam-lattice draft as very bad; asked for a short Liquid Glass scene with fluid motion, the same logo but improved, better typography and a premium feel. That draft was reverted and never committed.

base.supersedes: 4990055d boot arrival on feat/v3-boot-arrival-20261119 (unmerged); its rise/greeting choreography is replaced, its prompt/handoff behaviour is kept

design.sequence: mark as 22% glass ghost from frame 0; three liquid glass droplets curve into the lens (0-20); bezel forms (8-20); mark resolves (10-24); sheen flows and rests at 80% (18-40); rim glint (22-34); Meyar Sans wordmark gathers letter by letter (24-40); Meyar Arabic welcome (32-45); shutdown/reboot show the farewell
design.mark: owner vector master rendered at 2048 px, guided-filter cleaned (keeps internal design lines), Blender clear coat over rounded bevel/groove height; same silhouette and colours

hero.pin: artwork/verify_visuals.py moved to the new render under owner steering

renderer: Blender 5.3.0 (Flatpak, --unshare=network), Cycles CPU 160 samples on the V3 Ryzen 7 8840U

native.harness: private Xvfb in a --network none podman container from localhost/moos:latest 44.20261119 (its plymouth 24.004.60-24.1.moos1 libraries/script.so) with the vendor x11 review renderer; theme mounted read-only
native.states: shutdown (1920x1080, 2560x1600) and reboot (800x1280) show the farewell at rest; quit at frame 4 shows the full resting composition; Arabic passphrase with 4 bullets at 640x480 and 1920x1080

costVsPrevious.method: two captures 2.4 s apart (includes one PPM write each), three trials, same harness and image
costVsPrevious.boundary: X11 review renderer, not DRM/framebuffer boot time

fastHandoffReview.renderer: V3 Plymouth 24.004.60-24.1.moos1 on private Xvfb with the signed runtime libraries and script plugin.
fastHandoffReview.original: The 1.2 s native baseline was still animating. With a 2.8 s resting reference, the wordmark at 640x360 still differed from its prompt composition by up to two channel levels in x=295..343, y=242..252.
fastHandoffReview.repair: Reuse the four prescaled letter images once at the final tick. The full composition above the prompt now matches byte for byte. Arabic, long Latin and 200 ms input-redraw controls passed at 640x360, 800x480 and 640x480. Final renders include portrait, 1080p and 4K.

tests.tests/test_boot_splash_polish.py: 21 pass; executed callbacks, seven-size resting layout, glass decode/initramfs budget, asset provenance
negativeControls: removing the quit SetY keeps the in-flight offset (existing)
removing droplet retirement leaves a droplet on the resting frame
dropping the letters' margin compensation de-centres the wordmark
